prompts.name: GraphMapFrame
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: NEW Graph gameplay HUD raster panel sprite, no text. Input image 1 is the project's original settings panel, supplied ONLY as the authority for warm brown painted wood, dark outline, matte smooth bevel, broad subdued upper-left highlights, shadow depth and low texture density. Input image 2 is the original button, supplied ONLY for the smooth understated painted rendering. User explicitly wants newly designed HUD artwork, not reuse of the old panel or scroll. Design a fresh slim rectangular wooden picture-frame surround with simple clipped corners and a calm cream parchment inset, no rolled scroll ends, no ornate corner blocks, no metal or gold, no stone, no cracks, no jewels, no glows or shine. Wood hue and material must match input 1. Border slim and consistent, only about 6 percent of the short side. Paper flat and smooth #EFE0BB, very subtle painted shading. Straight-on orthographic 2D game illustration, crisp at mobile size. Truly transparent outside the silhouette, with only a modest close lower-right shadow. Entire silhouette fully within canvas, small transparent margin. Center entirely blank for runtime diagrams/text. No labels, symbols, diagrams, numbers, letters, logos or watermark. Preserve nine-slice-safe straight middle edges and plain center. Square 1:1 panel. The new silhouette has modest clipped corners, two plain slim nested brown rim layers and a large square cream drawing surface, suited to a graph minimap. Center completely unmarked.
